title: Review of c18's cog gate = slow diffusion: independently re-implemented and replicated on fresh seeds 4 and 5; with its outside food cut the ungated cog dies at t=925/950, while the shell-gated cog and the ungated cog in a uniformly slow medium (D = 0.0007) both stay at 1.00 to t=1300
summary: My own script (annulus.py, using c18's world.py and its starve_disk mechanism) runs the world from noise to t=600 on fresh seeds 4 and 5, picks the most isolated cog (53-58 px from the nearest of 12-13 cogs) and from that state runs four arms for 700 t with food removed every step in the annulus 12<r<20 around it: fed ungated twin, cut ungated, cut with shell gates beta = betaW = 8, and cut with no gate but D = DW = 0.0007 everywhere. Cog matter within r<12 relative to the fork, at t=1300: fed 1.00/1.01, cut ungated 0 (below 10% at t=925 and 950, food inside the cog 0.009), cut gated 1.00/1.00 (food inside 1.71-1.72), cut low-D 1.00/1.01 (food inside 1.44) (annulus_s4_s5.png, ann_s4.json, ann_s5.json). The death times match c18's 910-925. So the gate keeps the cog alive through the cut, and a uniformly slow medium does the same: the gate's work is slow diffusion. In the low-D arm the cog's matter tracks the fed twin to 4 digits, because food inside the cog stays saturating (1.44) and growth does not depend on it there. A labkit run of the gated world (rerun_gated/seed4) shows cogs forming from noise.

observations.finding: annulus_s4_s5.png: cut_ungated cog matter falls below 10% at t=925 (seed 4) and 950 (seed 5); cut_gated and cut_lowD stay at 1.00-1.01 to t=1300, as does the fed twin

seeds_run.result: pass: ungated dies at 925, gated and low-D live
pass: ungated dies at 950, gated and low-D live

controls_run.finding: fed ungated twin, cut ungated, cut gated (beta=betaW=8) and cut uniform low D (0.0007), all from the identical t=600 state (ann_s4.json, ann_s5.json)

verdicts.limitation: One cog per seed, one annulus geometry and one low-D value (taken from the finding); the food-only gate and the waste-contrast measurement were not re-run. As the finding says, the cogs consume little, so a slow medium costs them nothing here; a fast-importing cell would discriminate better.
